title: Sun and solar drying methods guide
context: Smallholder farmers lose produce to poor sun and solar drying methods; plain-language open guidance reduces loss.
objective: Write a plain-language guide to sun and solar drying methods summarizing established practice: why it matters, the practice, common mistakes, and sources.
acceptanceCriteria: Covers sun and solar drying methods as established general practice
General educational guidance only; no chemical dosing or farm-specific prescriptions
Cites >=2 authoritative open sources (e.g. FAO) with links
